messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — gpu_pool_queue_growth detected in aws-ca-central-1 (region). autoscaler attempted scaleup but instances stayed PENDING > 5m. Impact: increased inference latency and 429 throttles to a subset of customers. Pager severity: high.
jamie (oncall-sre): @kavita @sarah picking this up. seeing queue growth on gen models, request backlog ~2300. any immediate notes from infra?
kavita (eng-runtime): I'm seeing the autoscaler logs show API error from AWS when requesting new GPU instances: 
```
ERROR: RequestLimitExceeded: Service quota exceeded for resource 'p4d.24xlarge' in region aws-ca-central-1
status code: 400, request id: abcde-12345
```
kavita (eng-runtime): autoscaler retried but we hit account regional quota. no instance provisioning from our side.
sarah (infra): Confirmed — CA-CENTRAL account has a quota cap for GPU instance family. I just pulled the console and we've exhausted On-Demand/GPU capacity allocation. AWS returned 400s for multiple provisioning calls.
mike (oncall-ml): Immediate customer impact? olivia?
olivia (prod): Nate, any CS noise? We have a few customers reporting degraded perf for long-running chat contexts. Not full outage, but latency spikes and occasional 429s. 
nate (customer-success): I'm triaging two customers on paid Dedicated trials; I sent quick heads-up and mitigation steps. They're asking ETA.
jamie (oncall-sre): Short-term mitigation options: 1) divert new inference traffic to aws-us-west-2 and eu-west-1 pools (if capacity available) 2) scale down concurrency and reduce max_batch_size temporarily, 3) fall back to smaller instance types or CPU-based worker for low-priority traffic. Which do we want to do now?
kavita (eng-runtime): We can flip traffic routing rule on the router for non-low-latency tenants pretty quickly. Code snippets: 
```
# router change (prod)
POST /v1/routing/policies/traffic_shift
{"match":"tenant != 'gold'","target_region":"aws-us-west-2","percent":60}
```
kavita (eng-runtime): But that only helps if other regions have spare GPU capacity. I'll check capacity API across regions. Standby to run the shift.
sarah (infra): I can open a quota increase request to AWS Support but approval is not guaranteed and can take hours. I'll open it now and also request AWS capacity reservation via support case.
sarah (infra): case created: 9876543210. Submitted for 50 additional p4d-family vCPUs in ca-central-1. ETA unknown.
jamie (oncall-sre): Do immediate traffic diversion. kavita, prioritize routing for background/embedding jobs and low-priority customers, keep gold/enterprise pinned.
kavita (eng-runtime): Doing it now. Pushing the routing change to 60% -> us-west-2 for non-gold traffic.
incident-bot: Deploy bot: routing-policy-update succeeded (deploy-5791).
kavita (eng-runtime): Routing is live. We'll monitor queue. Initial numbers: backlog down from 2300 to ~800 in 3m. Latency partial recovery for diverted tenants.
mike (oncall-ml): Good. Any risk to model compatibility across region? model variants in us-west-2 are quantized slightly differently. We may see minor perf delta. Logging an eval flag for customers moved.
jamie (oncall-sre): Second mitigation: temporarily reduce default concurrency and max_batch_size for hosted API to reduce demand pressure. kavita — can you roll that?
kavita (eng-runtime): Yes, applying transient throttles: default concurrency 6 -> 3; max_batch_size 64 -> 32. Command: 
```
PATCH /v1/tenants/default/limits
{"concurrency":3,"max_batch_size":32}
```
incident-bot: config-change audit: limits-patch by kavita at 1759001860.
kavita (eng-runtime): Limits applied. Queue trending down to ~420. CPU workers taking some low-priority embedding jobs.
sarah (infra): Update on AWS case: support replied asking for estimated sustained usage and the business justification for quota bump. I submitted that; awaiting approval.
jamie (oncall-sre): Customer impact assessment: initial sampling shows ~2.8% of requests across the region had latency >2s additional tail; about 0.6% saw 429s/retries. No data exfiltration or errors beyond throttling. Please call out any affected enterprise customers.
nate (customer-success): Noted. I DM'd two enterprise POCs with status and mitigation steps. Asking if they'd like traffic pinned back to their region once we secure quota.
mike (oncall-ml): We're also seeing a secondary issue: KV cache warmup for diverted traffic increases first-request costs. Logging it to monitor cost/regression.
jamie (oncall-sre): Next actions: 1) sarah continue quota case and ask AWS capacity reservation 2) kavita keep routing and throttles in place; monitor for 30m 3) mike run a small smoke test with enterprise customers once we get their OK 4) olivia coordinate external comms if SLA thresholds breached.
olivia (prod): Preparing a short status note for affected customers and the status page. Will not post until we confirm stability in next 15m.
sarah (infra): AWS support updated: they can provision additional capacity if we accept a short-term placement group restriction (spot/ephemeral) or commit to reserved capacity. Asking if we accept ephemeral spot fallback for non-gold traffic.
jamie (oncall-sre): Approved for non-gold traffic only. Do not use spot for gold enterprise tenants. kavita please add a spot fallback pool and shift remaining non-gold there if needed.
kavita (eng-runtime): Creating spot pool fallback rule. Snippet: 
```
add_pool(name: "ca-central-1-spot-fallback", instance_type: "p4d", lifecycle: "spot", max_count: 40)
route("non-gold") -> pool("ca-central-1-spot-fallback") if on_demand_fail
```
incident-bot: pool-creation job queued (job 7763).
kavita (eng-runtime): Spot pool spun up partially — 12 instances so far, handling low-priority load. Backlog now ~190.
mike (oncall-ml): Monitoring correctness: models responding OK on spot nodes. No correctness regressions observed.
jamie (oncall-sre): After action summary (so far): routing diversion + concurrency throttles + spot fallback reduced backlog from 2300 -> 190 in ~40m. Primary root cause: regional GPU quota/capacity exhausted in aws-ca-central-1.
sarah (infra): AWS case still open, support asking for formal capacity reservation or quota increase. I'll keep pushing and escalate if needed.
olivia (prod): I'll prepare a customer-facing postmortem draft template and send to legal for sensitivity review if any enterprise names are included.
nate (customer-success): Customers we contacted are okay with traffic diversion; they'd like ETA for normal performance restoration. I'll ask them if they want to keep traffic routed.
mike (oncall-ml): I'll run a broader check for other regions to make sure we don't accidentally cause cascading capacity pressure when diverting.
jamie (oncall-sre): Handoff: I'm toggling primary oncall to sustained ops for the next 4 hours — @jamie will coordinate with infra and runtime for follow-ups. If AWS approves quota/reservation and we can shift back, we'll schedule a controlled rollback.
jamie (oncall-sre): Marking pager resolved for immediate urgency — backlog stabilizing and customer impact reduced. Will keep thread open for final closure and postmortem. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Pager status changed: acknowledged -> mitigated at 1759004120.
jamie (oncall-sre): Final notes for postmortem: timestamp range 1759001234-1759004120, mitigations applied, quota request id 9876543210, routing deploy-5791, limits-patch audit. Please add any logs/snippets to the incident doc.
olivia (prod): Copy. I'll start the incident doc and tag owners for RCA.
